classification.difficultyReason: Read two marked integer axis crossings on a numbered unit grid and record coordinate pairs. No equation inference or interpolation is required.

content.prompt: Write down the $x$-intercept and the $y$-intercept of the line.

spec.description: Unit grid x=-2 to 5, y=-3 to 3, numbered unit ticks, one blue line with its two axis crossings marked.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph and ticks are permanent givens; intercept coordinate answers are hidden.

answer.worked: The line crosses the $x$-axis at $x=3$, so the $x$-intercept is $(3,0)$. The line crosses the $y$-axis at $y=-2$, so the $y$-intercept is $(0,-2)$.
